start: A workout open in MettleUp, a rest running with about 2 min left, phone locked

steps.action: Restart the phone mid-rest and unlock it, without opening MettleUp
user_sees: The rest card is back in the notification shade with 'Next: <exercise, set>', the countdown still running from the old end time, and 'Done', '+15 s', 'Skip'
must_not: The rest card missing until MettleUp is opened
The countdown starting again from the full rest length

steps.action: Wait for the rest to run out
user_sees: 'Rest is over' with sound and buzz, on the lock screen, with 'Complete set'
must_not: No 'Rest is over' on the phone while the watch buzzes
Two 'Rest is over' alerts for one rest

steps.action: Let 'Rest is over' go by itself or swipe it away
user_sees: The live workout card comes back with the next set and 'Complete set'
must_not: No workout card at all after the restart
A set logged without a tap

start: A workout open, a rest running, Google Play updates MettleUp in the background

steps.action: Let Play update MettleUp mid-rest (do not open the app)
user_sees: The rest card is posted again with the same end time; the alarm is set again
must_not: The rest card gone for good after the update
A 'Rest is over' at once for a rest still running

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end
user_sees: 'Rest is over' on time
must_not: A silent rest end because the alarm was lost in the update

start: Android 12+, 'Alarms & reminders' off for MettleUp, a rest running with the app in the background

steps.action: Open Android Settings, Apps, MettleUp, 'Alarms & reminders' and switch it on, then lock the phone
user_sees: The running rest's alarm is set again as an exact alarm
must_not: The member having to come back to MettleUp before this rest becomes exact

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end with the phone asleep
user_sees: 'Rest is over' on the second, not minutes late
must_not: 'Ended N min ago' on a rest that should have been on time

tests.checks: s1 see (source text): Android's 'Alarms & reminders allowed' broadcast is listened for and re-arms the running rest; the on-time ring (s2) is not checked
s1 see (source text): Android's 'Alarms & reminders allowed' broadcast is listened for and re-arms the running rest; the on-time ring (s2) is not checked

start: A workout open, a 90 s rest running

steps.action: Switch the phone off, wait 5 minutes (the rest ends while it is off), switch it on and unlock
user_sees: No 'Rest is over' (the ended rest is forgotten quietly); the live workout card with 'Complete set' is back
must_not: A late 'Rest is over' that rings mid-set
A rest card counting below zero

start: A workout started yesterday and never finished, its live card last updated over an hour ago

steps.action: Restart the phone
user_sees: No live workout card comes back (a workout left open for hours is not brought back)
must_not: A stale card whose 'Complete set' logs a set and starts a rest days later

steps.action: Open MettleUp
user_sees: The open workout as the app shows it; the app decides about its own card
must_not: The open workout lost because of the restart

start: A rest running, phone restarted, phone lying on a gym bench locked

steps.action: Look at the locked phone after the restart
user_sees: The rest card and later 'Rest is over' show the next exercise and set on the lock screen (public visibility)
must_not: Anything beyond the exercise name and set on the lock screen (no body weight, no gym or member details)
Any of it sent off the phone except to the member's own watch app

start: Phone finishes starting up; a rest was saved with an end time still in the future

steps.action: Android sends 'boot completed' to MettleUp's receiver
user_sees: The rest card is posted again, the end alarm armed for the saved end time, the rest re-sent to the watch, the live card restored if kept within the last hour
must_not: The receiver crashing and taking the app's start with it
The alarm armed for a different time than the saved end

start: MettleUp has just been updated (package replaced), or the member allowed 'Alarms & reminders'

steps.action: Android sends 'my package replaced'
user_sees: The same recovery as after a restart; a 'Rest is over' still up is respected and the live card waits for it
must_not: Two copies of the live card
A second 'Rest is over' for the same rest

steps.action: Android sends 'exact alarm permission changed'
user_sees: Only a running rest's alarm is set again (exact now); nothing else changes
must_not: A rest that already ended being alerted again

tests.checks: s2 see (source text): the 'Alarms & reminders allowed' broadcast re-arms the running rest; the update path, duplicate cards and a second alert are not checked
s2 see (source text): the 'Alarms & reminders allowed' broadcast re-arms the running rest; the update path, duplicate cards and a second alert are not checked

start: Phone starts up with no saved rest and no kept workout card

steps.action: Android sends 'boot completed'
user_sees: Nothing is posted
must_not: An empty rest card or an empty workout card
An error notification

start: Phone starts up; the saved rest ended while the phone was off

steps.action: Android sends 'boot completed'
user_sees: The saved rest is forgotten and its alarm removed; no alert is posted
must_not: A late 'Rest is over'
The forgotten rest coming back on the next app open
